title: Token Issuance Accounting - DemoCo DEMO Token, Q2 2026
conclusionSummary: The SAFT proceeds of 1,000,000 USD are a liability to deliver DEMO tokens (not equity, not a derivative pre-launch); the public sale proceeds of 500,000 USD are a contract liability under ASC 606 because the token conveys platform services DemoCo must still provide; the treasury allocation and the airdrop received no consideration and recognize no asset or liability.
